content:
Ava: lunchtime thought: we should make an "LLM Gossip Bingo" for the office. who wants a square?
Diego: I call "mentions 'context window' in casual convo". already heard it twice today. :eyes:
Mira: I'll take 'uses 'token budget' as a flirt line' — overheard in kitchen last week. :coffee:
chip-bot: infra-bot: inserting bingo card template into the thread. (reaction :card_index:)
Ava: chip-bot nailed it. also add 'hallucination tells a compelling origin story for a plant' — very specific but true. :seedling:
DesignRuth: I'm drawing stickers for each square. tiny bingo chips: a burrito, an umbrella (fallback), a flashing GPU.
Diego: add a code-square: someone posts an in-thread prompt with triple backticks. e.g.
```
user: give me 3 playlist names inspired by latency spikes
```
Mira: omg yes. and a square for "someone suggests quantizing the office speaker". happened on the 3rd pizza Friday. :pizza:
Ava: vote: should we make it physical (stickers + printed cards) or digital? react with :one: physical, :two: digital.
Diego: physical is superior. more chance of actual trash talk.
chip-bot: event-bot: poll updated: physical=5 digital=2. :bar_chart:
Mira: prize idea: winner gets a sticker pack and naming rights for the next anonymous hallucination in #random. :trophy:
DesignRuth: naming rights should come with a tiny ribbon that says "I survived the hallucination".
Ava: ok next step: @DesignRuth to draft stickers, @chip-bot to generate printable bingo grid, and @Mira to source non-lethal confetti. tagging all. :sparkles:
